context: Two sisters reminisce about past travels at home
purpose: Teach: スイス/スウェーデン/ギリシャ/シンガポール/中東/自国/東北/めぐる

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: アルバム見てたら、新婚旅行でスイスの時計を買った写真が出てきたわ。
lines.en: Looking through the album, I found a photo of us buying a Swiss watch on our honeymoon.
lines.style: Warm nostalgic tone, soft pacing, gentle laugh in the voice.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 懐かしい!あの後スウェーデン家具のお店もめぐったよね、二人で。
lines.en: How nostalgic! After that we also toured Swedish furniture shops together, the two of us.
lines.style: Bright, animated reminiscing, slightly higher pitch, fond chuckle.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: そうそう、で珍しく予算オーバーして、帰りはギリシャ料理の安い店で済ませたのよ。
lines.en: Right, and unusually we went over budget, so on the way back we settled for a cheap Greek restaurant.
lines.style: Self-deprecating laugh, conversational rhythm, mock embarrassment.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: あの旅、夫がシンガポール出張のついでに合流してくれて、何だか夢みたいだったな。
lines.en: On that trip my husband joined us after his Singapore business trip, it felt kind of like a dream.
lines.style: Wistful, slower delivery, voice trailing softly at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 今は中東情勢も不安定だし、なるべく自国の文化を見直そうって話してたよね。
lines.en: Now with the Middle East situation unstable too, we talked about reappraising our own country's culture as much as possible.
lines.style: Thoughtful, lowered tone, measured and reflective pacing.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: うん、それで去年は東北新幹線に乗って、温泉をめぐる旅にしたんだった。
lines.en: Yeah, that's why last year we took the Tohoku Shinkansen and made it a hot spring tour.
lines.style: Cheerful recollection, warm and conversational, slight smile audible.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 現地のおばあちゃんに手作りのお漬物を貰って、いまだに味が忘れられないわ。
lines.en: A local grandma gave us homemade pickles, and even now I can't forget the taste.
lines.style: Dreamy, savoring memory, slight pause before the final phrase.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: ね。次は姉さんの定年退職祝いに、また二人で旅に出ようよ。
lines.en: Right? Next time, to celebrate your retirement, let's go on a trip together again.
lines.style: Affectionate, encouraging, gentle upward inflection at the invitation.
